title: Compatible open chart gluing of local universal thickenings
statement: Let $h:Z\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $C$ a universe-small open cover of $Z$, and $i_k:C_k\to Z'_k$, $h'_k:Z'_k\to X$ universal first order thickenings of $C.f_k$ followed by $h$ [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening]. There exist a scheme $W$ and open immersions $e_k:Z'_k\to W$ [def-weil-open-immersion] whose images cover $W$, such that (1) the maps $h'_k$ agree on the categorical pullbacks of $e_k$ and $e_l$; (2) the maps $e_k\circ i_k$ agree on the categorical pullbacks of $C.f_k$ and $C.f_l$; and (3) for every $k,l$ and point $z\in C_l$, $e_l(i_l(z))$ lies in the image of $e_k$ if and only if $C.f_l(z)$ lies in the image of $C.f_k$. No global morphism from $Z$, global morphism to $X$, or cartesian square is asserted.

source.place: Tag 04F3, proof: the two paragraphs beginning Choose an affine open covering and By the general remarks; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04F3

proof.text: Obtain the compatible local overlap glue data D, its index equivalence a, chart isomorphisms b, source lifts and inverse-image characterization. This is only the overlap and cocycle construction, before forming an ambient scheme.

Take W=D.glued and e(k)=b(k).hom followed by D.ι(a(k)). Mathlib gives open immersions and joint surjectivity. For base compatibility, lift the pullback of e(k),e(l) to the limit cone D.vPullbackCone; compose the local base equation with the lift and cancel b(k),b(l). For source compatibility compose the two factorizations of s(k,l) with the chart maps and use D.glue_condition. Finally D.ι_eq_iff identifies the inverse image of the image of chart k under chart l with the image of f(a(l),a(k)); use the local inverse-image characterization. Index equivalence and chart isomorphisms transfer surjectivity without any inhabitedness assumption.

theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_cartesianAtlas_core
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (C : Z.OpenCover.{u})
    (Z' : C.I₀ → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ k, C.X k ⟶ Z' k)
    (h' : ∀ k, Z' k ⟶ X)
    (H : ∀ k, IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening (C.f k ≫ h) (i k) (h' k)) :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (e : ∀ k, Z' k ⟶ W),
      (∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (e k)) ∧ (∀ w : W, ∃ k z, e k z = w) ∧
      (∀ k l, pullback.fst (e k) (e l) ≫ h' k = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ h' l) ∧
      (∀ k l, pullback.fst (C.f k) (C.f l) ≫ (i k ≫ e k) =
        pullback.snd _ _ ≫ (i l ≫ e l)) ∧
      ∀ k l (z : C.X l),
        e l (i l z) ∈ Set.range (e k) ↔ C.f l z ∈ Set.range (C.f k)
